# Delta: cursor/sidecar-helper-7208 (PR #7211) — the helper is NOT dead: restore it, fix the record (same branch, on top)

PR #7211 was kicked from the merge queue (run 32684231450, shard 4/4): four `[repo-root]`-parametrized tests in
`tests/test_delegate.py` (`test_read_only_dispatch_allows_entire_harness_telemetry`, `…_allows_harness_runtime_state`,
`…_still_fails_on_tracked_mutation_with_entire_telemetry`, `…_with_runtime_state`) now fail:
`assert ['tasks/read-only-…-repo-root.snapshots/read_only_checkout_pre.json', 'tracked.txt'] == ['tracked.txt']`.
Your original claim was right: for a repo-root dispatch the sidecar is seen as `tasks/<id>.snapshots/…` (no `batch_state/`
prefix), so the `batch_state` dir-name exemption does not cover it and `_is_read_only_delegate_snapshot_sidecar_path`
(suffix-shape match) is the guard that keeps the snapshot out of the mutation diff. The review adjudication that called it
dead was wrong; the driver accepted it wrongly.

## Do
1. Restore `_is_read_only_delegate_snapshot_sidecar_path` and its call site exactly as on origin/main.
2. Keep your new real-path test (`batch_state/tasks/<id>.snapshots/…` exempt via the runtime-state check) AND restore the
   `tasks/…` test with a CORRECT docstring: "repo-root dispatches observe the sidecar as `tasks/<id>.snapshots/…`; the
   `batch_state` dir-name exemption does not apply there — see tests/test_delegate.py [repo-root] cases".
3. Keep the runbook addition.
4. Acceptance (quote raw output; PRIMARY interpreter, WITHOUT LU_ALLOW_NOTEBOOK_DISPATCH):
   `/Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/test_delegate_readonly_guard.py
   tests/test_delegate_runtime_tmp_sweep.py "tests/test_delegate.py" -k "read_only or readonly or sidecar or sweep"` green
   (the four repo-root tests must pass); ruff clean. Mutation check: remove the helper again → the four fail; restore → pass.
5. One conventional commit on top (`fix(delegate): restore the sidecar-exempt guard for repo-root dispatches (#7208)`,
   X-Agent trailer). NO push, NO amend, NO rebase, NO auto-merge. Report new HEAD SHA + evidence.
